capabilities: Sync the vault in real time to a self-hosted NAS
Retain deleted files in trash after sync
Administer sync through a web console
extras: The README is mostly Korean and only points to a release zip for installation; details like the NAS server setup live outside the README. The listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid hosted service, so users who want real-time vault syncing through their own hardware have no built-in option.
summary: Self-hosted vault sync that mirrors your notes in real time to your own NAS with conflict tracking, trash retention, and a web admin console.
